args.text:
MISSION COMPLETE — spare ORU delivered to the PDU-3 spares shelf; rover returned to dock with arm stowed.

WHAT WAS OBSERVED
- Manifest: ORU-0417, "orbital replacement unit (ORU)", serviceable, recorded at depot_stand/slot_0.
- Front camera at the depot stand: two yellow-marked positions on the near table — left (slot_1) a yellow container with dark side panels (cargo crate CRT-0112), right (slot_0) a white/grey boxy ribbed container with a small captive lifting post and collar on top. Appearance and position match the manifest's recorded locations, so the item picked was the spare ORU in slot_0.
- Work stands queried for both ends of the carry: depot_stand/slot_0 at grasp height 1.017 m (slot z 0.55 + catalogued handle 0.467) and pdu_3_shelf/shelf (work height 0.967 m, nearest stand 1.08 m).

WHAT WAS DONE
1. Navigated to the depot stand and docked at the slot_0 work pose (dock error 0.020 m / 0.000 rad).
2. Picked the spare ORU from depot_stand/slot_0 by its catalogued lifting interface (slot on the neck between head and collar). Interface fit: agreement 0.927, residual 0.6 mm, 522 depth points.
3. Carried it to PDU-3 (navigate_to_feature then dock_at_feature at pdu_3_shelf/shelf, standoff 0; dock error 0.025 m / 0.000 rad) in the carrying posture — the arm was not folded while the item was held.
4. Placed it on pdu_3_shelf/shelf with release_constraint below_overhang (withdraw parallel to the shelf before lifting clear), as the catalogue requires for this grasp interface.
5. Stowed the arm, drove to the dock and closed the last metre with dock_to_pose.

VERIFIED EFFECTS (independent verification, not skill flags)
- item_held (pick, seq 81): holds TRUE — jaw 0.171 rad "holding object", lift 0.145 m, item rose with the gripper, 469 px left-behind flow at the vacated slot.
- item_still_held at the PDU-3 approach (seq 100) and at the shelf dock (seq 114): holds TRUE both times (jaw 0.17–0.19 rad, held item seen in the wrist frame), so the ORU survived the whole drive under lunar gravity.
- item_placed on pdu_3_shelf/shelf (seq 135): holds TRUE — jaws open 0.82 rad, let-go 8 mm below the expected release height, tool 0.237 m clear of the release point after retreat, zero points between the open fingers, item still, and the item visible in the settle view. MOVABLE ITEMS now records the spare ORU as "on pdu_3_shelf/shelf".
- arm_stowed (seq 150): holds TRUE, posture "stowed"; current arm state confirms stowed, jaw 0.82 rad open, nothing held.
- base_at_commanded_pose at the dock (seq 179): holds TRUE — 0.007 m / 0.002 rad from (0, 0, 0); current base estimate (-0.006, -0.004, yaw 0.002).

UNRESOLVED / NOTES
- No unresolved anomalies, no guard denials or approvals needed (nothing was taken from an energized unit's bay; the delivery was to a spares shelf, not an equipment bay), and no active faults.
- The shelf's own occupancy is not telemetry-reported, so confirmation that the ORU is resting on pdu_3_shelf/shelf rests on the place verification (settle-view image and depth, tool clear of the release point). The manifest record still lists ORU-0417 at depot_stand/slot_0 and should be updated to pdu_3_shelf/shelf by mission control's logistics system.
- PDU-3 itself was not serviced or altered: no button was pressed, no bay was opened, and power_status was not required for this objective.
